svg.text: Replication: followers fetch the same bytes and append them in order; a record is committed once it is on every in-sync replica (ISR).

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: · Offsets are per partition and monotonic — global ordering only exists inside one partition.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: · HW is what consumers may read; LEO is where the leader is writing. The gap is replication lag.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: · A consumer’s committed offset is its replay point: reset it backwards and you reprocess, not corrupt.
